test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the first Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI) report released in April 2025, which two states are leading with the highest number of “front runner” panchayats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat and Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI):** The **Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI)** is a comprehensive report introduced to measure the performance and development of panchayats across India. It is aimed at promoting rural governance and ensuring effective delivery of public services at the grassroots level.
 
• **Release in April 2025:** The first report of the PAI was released in **April 2025**. It highlights the states that have performed exceptionally well in terms of panchayat governance and development.
 
• **Gujarat and Telangana:** According to the report, **Gujarat and Telangana** are leading with the highest number of “front runner” panchayats. This showcases their commitment to rural development and effective governance. *Hence, the correct answer is Gujarat and Telangana.*
 
• **Criteria for evaluation:** The PAI evaluates panchayats based on multiple factors such as **governance practices, delivery of services, infrastructure development, education, health, and economic activities.**
 
• **Front runner panchayats:** These are panchayats that excel in multiple indicators and are models of efficiency and development, contributing significantly to rural progress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Features of Panchayat Advancement Index:**

 
 
• **Objective:** The primary objective of the PAI is to assess the performance of panchayats in fostering rural development and improving governance.
 
• **Indicators:** It includes indicators related to **healthcare, education, infrastructure, sanitation, employment, women empowerment, and environmental sustainability**.
 
• **Data collection:** The report is based on **extensive data collection** from various government and non-governmental sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
 
 
 
• **Performance of Gujarat and Telangana:**
 
 
• **Gujarat:** Known for its **progressive rural policies and initiatives**, Gujarat has focused on improving infrastructure, sanitation, and women's participation in governance.
 
• **Telangana:** Telangana has implemented innovative schemes for rural development, such as **Mission Bhagiratha** for drinking water supply and **Palle Pragathi** for village development.
 
 
 
• **Significance of PAI:**
 
 
• The PAI helps identify model panchayats that can serve as benchmarks for other regions.
 
• It aims to enhance transparency, accountability, and efficiency in rural governance.
 
• The index provides actionable insights for policymakers to improve rural development strategies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Additional characteristics of options:**

 
 
• **Chhattisgarh and Uttar Pradesh:** While these states have made efforts in rural development, they are not leading in the PAI report.
 
• **Assam and West Bengal:** These states also have progressive initiatives but do not feature as front runners in the PAI.
 
• **Meghalaya and Nagaland:** Known for their unique governance models, these states focus on local participation but are not leading in the PAI rankings.
 
 
 
• **Reports and indices:** The PAI aligns with India's efforts to achieve the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** at the grassroots level.
